svg.text: Fuel sender stand-in on a 2 × 8 cm protoboard (6 × 28 holes)
Untested on hardware. Same circuit as fuel_gauge_wiring.png.
2. Solder side (board flipped left-to-right): grey = solder bridges
• Rails: row A columns 16–27 = SENSE (to cluster pin 2). Row F columns 2–27 = GROUND (to cluster pin 1 and Mega GND).
• Double-sided board: parts on top, bridges on the bottom. Bridge only where grey lines are drawn; other pads aren't connected. Bare tinned wire laid on the pads is easier for long runs.
• 2N7000 legs in column 11, rows B/C/D = D/G/S, flat face toward column 12. Check the leg order against your part's datasheet.
• 470 µF: + leg in column 20 row B, − (striped) leg in column 20 row D. 470 Ω spans rows A–F in column 24 (bend the leads). Wires solder into the coloured pads.
